ops.title: Separate paused registration retirement from physical cross-volume relocation
ops.description: Owner: /root/ccx_targeted_stack_io. Actual supported paused retirement of 304 selected monorepo registrations yielded eight cross-volume refusals before journal admission. Evidence: fundamental-efficiency/ccx-all-valid-inactive-registration-cohort-bookend.private.json and remaining-even/odd result.private.json. Loaded helper73 relocate/preflight.go screen unconditionally requires checkout and jobs directory on same volume; Pend uses inspect before logical retirement although Retire changes only registration metadata. Next: isolate the physical relocation volume requirement from paused logical admission; preserve all captured directory/HEAD/branch/link identity, current activity, submodule, lock and replacement protections. Physical deletion remains paused. Ordinary active acceptance and deferred removal retain their existing early physical relocation refusal. Advance must refuse cross-volume before restoring a retired registration or moving payload. Source, independent security review, actual regression/CI, merge/release/install and affected eight-case verification remain required.

ops.text: Real cross-volume fixture retires paused registration with exact payload inode and Expected/activity protections preserved; unpaused movement remains refused before mutation.
Independent security review and CI pass on actual source, normal merge/release/local helper adoption verified.
The eight proven refused candidates are reprocessed through supported API, with actual retired/pending/blocked results and physical pause preserved.
